headerDisplay:
Controls the Bluetooth-only Dyson Solarcycle / Lightcycle Morph.

**The lamp must be registered in the MyDyson app.** Its key is issued by Dyson against the account the lamp belongs to and cannot be read from the device itself.

Each lamp becomes two accessories in the Home app: the light itself, and a second one holding the switches below.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Homebridge log in front of this plugin’s messages.

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Leave empty to use the system default adapter.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: Printed on the lamp base and shown in the MyDyson app.

autoBrightnessSwitch.title: Expose auto brightness
autoBrightnessSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's "Auto" setting, which trims brightness to keep the room at a steady level.

movementSwitch.title: Expose movement mode
movementSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's movement mode, where it lights on movement and goes out once the room has been still.

presetSwitches.title: Expose the preset modes
presetSwitches.description: Adds the lamp's Study, Relax and Precision modes as switches. Only one can be on at a time, which the lamp itself enforces.

daylightSwitch.title: Expose daylight tracking
daylightSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's daylight tracking, which adjusts colour temperature to the time of day. It reports the true state, following the button on the lamp base and the MyDyson app, and setting a colour temperature by hand ends the tracking as the lamp itself decides.

footerDisplay: Lamp keys are stored in the plugin's storage directory, never in config.json. Your MyDyson password is only needed while authorising — clear it afterwards.
